classes.name: PolicyResolutionModule
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface produces one permitted route or denial and owns policy-scope precedence, regression safeguards, privacy and capability gates, route overrides, cost-tier and portfolio selection, runtime canonicalization, and fallback projection.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Chisei callers, translates protocol messages, and delegates domain routing input to Policy resolution.

classes.name: GatewayExecutionDecision
classes.description: Governed gateway execution decision that consumes Policy resolution through its private domain interface.

relations.name: delegates_policy_resolution_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates policy resolution after caller authentication.

relations.name: resolves_route_through
relations.description: Gateway execution obtains its governed route through the Policy resolution domain interface.
